welcome.title: Welcome to Better Vault
welcome.lead: Bring your material, understand it, practise it, and remember it.
welcome.body: Books, PDFs, articles, YouTube lectures and your own notes. Everything stays on this device, and you choose the AI, or none.
welcome.steps: Three short steps: your name, your AI, your first material. The AI is optional.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.description: Your name appears in the app, on this device only.
name.label: Your name
name.hint: Optional. You can change it in Settings.

ai.title: Choose your AI
ai.description: Ask, Practice and Make use it. It is optional: reading, highlights, cards and review work without one, and you can add it later in Settings.
ai.connected: An AI is connected. You can change it any time in Settings.
ai.keyBody: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenCode. You pay the provider for what you use, and the key stays on this device.
ai.localBody: Ollama, LM Studio. Free, and runs on your computer, so nothing leaves your device.
ai.planBody: From $4.99 a month. It needs an account; your notebooks stay on this device.

material.title: Add your first material
material.description: One box takes anything. It opens in the reader, ready to ask about.
material.label: Link or text to add
material.placeholder: Paste a link or some text
material.examples: For example: a YouTube lecture, a PDF, an article, your notes.
material.goesTo: Goes to {{notebook}}, where new material lands. You can move it later.

upgrade.title: A few things have moved
upgrade.notebooks: Your books now live in notebooks
upgrade.notebooksBody: Each one is in the sidebar under Notebooks, and all of them are in Library.
upgrade.chats: Your chats are in one history
upgrade.chatsBody: Notebook chats and reader questions are together now. Open History in Ask.
upgrade.review: All your flashcards are in Review
upgrade.reviewBody: One deck. Each card still belongs to its notebook.
upgrade.footer: Nothing else changes. Everything you had is still here, on this device.
